messages:
Kay: Quick post-mortem from the midnight canary: ~0.6% of hosts continued serving epoch 123 after activation for epoch 125. Looks like resolver used a stale manifest snapshot. My proposal: extend rollout metadata with a narrow-cutover surface: transition_epoch (int), grace_ms (int), dry_run (bool), eviction_policy (enum), rollout_token (string). Hosts should log "pin_would_evict" when dry_run=true.

Ravi: Can you paste the short log? I want to confirm timing.

Kay: Log: `host-19 restore pin model=oss-tiny epoch=123; rollout.activate(epoch=125) @+9s; serve(epoch=123) @+17s`

Tess: Yikes. transition_epoch + dry_run makes sense. Also add `debounce_ms` so hosts don't immediately re-request on rollback.

Omar: Agree. Suggest eviction_policy values: soft | immediate | deferred. Default soft means eligible after grace_ms. immediate = ignore grace_ms. deferred for manual ops.

Ravi: Ops note: deployment tool should support dry_run mode that writes metadata with dry_run=true and a signed rollout_token. We'll collect `pin_would_evict` telemetry for 24-48h before flipping enforcement.

Tess: Telemetry fields to add: pin_seen_epoch, pin_would_evict, pin_evicted_epoch, pin_apply_epoch. Add alert when >0.5% hosts report pin_seen_epoch < transition_epoch after 10m.

Kay: Example rollout metadata we can add to RFC: `{"rollout_id":"r-2026-09-cut","target":"oss-tiny@125","transition_epoch":125,"grace_ms":20000,"debounce_ms":30000,"dry_run":true,"eviction_policy":"soft","rollout_token":"sig:xxxxx"}`

Omar: Also document compat_version. Older runtimes should ignore unknown fields; new runtimes should check compat_version to know whether to honor transition_epoch.

Ravi: Edge-case: rapid flip (A->B->A) could cause thrash. With debounce_ms enforced on hosts, re-adoption requires explicit re-pin or force. We'll require deploy tool to set force flag to override debounce.

sre-bot: Created follow-up ticket INF-1246: add telemetry + deploy dry_run support. Assigned to Tess and Ravi.

Kay: I'll update the RFC with fields, staged rollout plan (telemetry -> dry_run -> enforce), and examples. Thanks everyone.
